GITOPS_GIT_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained GitHub PAT for this repository only: Contents read/write (bootstrap pushes the cluster config).

GITOPS_FLUX_GIT_TOKEN.description: Optional fine-grained PAT with Contents read-only, stored in the cluster for Flux instead of GITOPS_GIT_TOKEN.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Runtime token stored SOPS-encrypted for cert-manager: Zone / DNS: Edit and Zone / Zone: Read on your domain.

CLOUDFLARE_SETUP_TOKEN.description: One-time token for tunnel, DNS and Access setup (Cloudflare Tunnel, Access Apps and Policies: Edit; Access Organizations: Read; Zone / DNS: Edit). Never stored in the repo or cluster; revoke after bootstrap.

SOPS_AGE_KEY.description: Contents of ~/.sops/age.agekey from the first bootstrap, restored on every start so secrets stay decryptable after the codespace is deleted.
